form.name: Tournament Name *
form.groupsCountHint: How many groups players will be split into.
form.qualifiersPerGroupHint: How many players from each group advance to the knockout bracket.
form.swissRoundsHint: Everyone plays every round against opponents on a similar score. Leave rounds empty for the standard count.
form.directQualifiersPlaceholder: All {{count}} direct — enter fewer to add a play-in
form.knockoutHint: Single: one loss and you're out. Double: a losers bracket gives everyone a second chance before elimination.
form.reservesHint: When OFF, the roster is the lineup — every member plays.
form.exclusiveHint: When ON, only hub members with the Exclusive role (or admins/owner) can see and join this tournament.
form.requireApprovalHint: When ON, the opposing participant must confirm a reported result. The hub owner or admin can override.
form.thirdPlaceHint: Adds a third place match between the semi-final losers. Skipped if the bracket ends up with fewer than 4 entrants.
form.doubleRoundRobinHint: Every pair plays twice — one home leg and one away leg. Doubles the match count.
form.roundDurationHint: How long each round stays open before results are due.
form.reservesDetailHint: Extra squad slots on top of the {{lineup}} players who play. Teams can fill anywhere from 0 up to this many — the bench is optional. Captains swap a reserve in for a starter between rounds, and the reserve always takes that player's exact game.
form.scheduleHint: Leave empty and sign-ups open right away. Pick a time and the tournament stays closed until then — everyone is notified the moment it opens.
form.swissPlayInHint: Top {{direct}} go straight to the bracket. Standings {{from}}–{{to}} play one play-in round (best vs worst) for the remaining {{spots}} spots.
form.swissDirectHint: Top {{size}} from the standings are seeded into the bracket (1 vs {{size}}, 2 vs {{second}}, …).
form.lockedNotice: The tournament has started — only the description, rules and result approval can still be changed.
form.requireApprovalHintShort: Opponent must confirm a reported result. Owner / admin can override.
form.opensClosedNotice: Sign-ups are closed until this time. To start them now, use Open Registration on the tournament page.
form.swissPlayInHintShort: Top {{direct}} go straight to the bracket. Standings {{from}}–{{to}} play one play-in round for the remaining {{spots}} spots.
form.thirdPlaceHintEdit: Adds a third place match between the semi-final losers. Skipped if the bracket ends up with fewer than 4 entrants. Takes effect when the bracket is generated.
